# Sample Shop

Build with `npm run build`, test with `npm test` and fix lint with `yarn lint:fix`.
Then npm run build again in prose, if you like.

```sh
npm ci
pnpm run start
make
make build
make -C tools gen
make guide.pdf
npm run dev --prefix web
npm run --if-present maybe
yarn add left-pad
# make sure everything is installed first
```

```console
$ make docker-build
docker
```
